title: Intersection of Multiple Arrays
description:
You are given a 2D array nums.

Each nums[i] is a list of distinct positive integers
Task

Find all integers that are present in every array.
If not then return [-1]
Return them:

In ascending order
input_format:
The first line contains two integers n and m.
The next n lines each contain one inner array as space-separated integers.
m represents the maximum allowed size for an inner array in this input format.
output_format: Print space-separated integers in one line.
constraints:
1 ≤ number of arrays ≤ 1000
Total elements ≤ 1000
1 ≤ value ≤ 1000
Each inner array has unique elements
